# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia milestone m148 with variable-font and WebP support. It rolls up all 4.147.x preview work: variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, a reworked singleton lifecycle, and the final promotion of v3-era obsolete APIs to compile errors. This is a breaking release — review the changes before upgrading from 3.x.

## Breaking Changes

- **SKPaint text/font members are now compile errors** — The text and font members on SKPaint that were marked Obsolete in v3 (Typeface, TextSize, etc.) are now errors. Move typeface and text-size settings to SKFont. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality and was renamed** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo was retyped from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. The old type lost IEquatable<T> and its == / != operators. Update any equality checks to use the new type.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed** — The protected set accessor on IgnorePublicDispose was removed; it can only be set from the constructor. Custom SKNativeObject subclasses that assigned this property must switch to the constructor parameter.
- **new SKFont() typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty, not null** — Upstream Skia m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs) instead of null. MeasureText returns 0 and nothing is drawn unless you supply an explicit typeface. Pass SKTypeface.Default (or any loaded typeface) to restore drawing behaviour. ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560))
- **new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null** — new SKPaint().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Default (non-null). Code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect an unset typeface no longer fires; use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty, or drop the check since a usable default is always present. ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName for an unknown family returns Default on Android** — On Android, looking up an unknown font family now returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Null checks on the return value must be replaced with IsEmpty checks. ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560))
- **Vulkan 1.0 instances are no longer tolerated — the process aborts** — Skia now calls SK_ABORT (process termination, not a catchable exception) when a Vulkan 1.0 instance or device is used. Set VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to at least VK_API_VERSION_1_1.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative: five fields removed** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed from GRVkBackendContextNative. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions, fDeviceFeatures / fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures, and delete the rest.
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo layout changed — new Components field added** — A new Components field (GRVkYcbcrComponents struct) was added to GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo, changing its binary layout. Code that manually constructs or marshals the struct must add the new field.
- **Singleton lifecycle reworked — SKObject handles may be recreated** — The internal singleton-instance tracking was rewritten. Objects that were previously cached forever may now be recreated; code that compared SKObject instances by reference identity (rather than by handle) may see new instances. This also fixes finalization-order crashes. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))

## Engine

- **Skia engine upgraded from m132 through m148** — The bundled Skia engine advanced through milestones m132, m133, and m147, landing at the m148 stable release, bringing years of upstream rendering improvements and bug fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Multiple upstream chrome/m147 stability syncs** — Two rounds of upstream chrome/m147 bug fixes were merged, pulling in Ganesh correctness and stability improvements. ([#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081))

## API Surface

- **Variable font support added to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp** — Variable fonts (OpenType font variations) are now fully supported. SKFont and SKTypeface expose variation axes and named instances, and HarfBuzzSharp gains matching shaping support. Color font palettes are also exposed. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))
- **Animated WebP encoding via SKWebpEncoder** — SKWebpEncoder now supports encoding animated WebP sequences, giving .NET apps a first-class animated image output format. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion** — A new SKStream.GetData() method returns the underlying data buffer without copying when the stream supports it, reducing allocations in codec and serialization paths. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface accept SKSamplingOptions** — Both drawing methods gained a SKSamplingOptions overload, giving callers explicit control over filtering quality when compositing surfaces. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **HBColor value type and missing HarfBuzz API wrappers added** — HBColor is a new struct giving proper .NET representation to hb_color_t. Gaps in the HarfBuzz binding surface were filled and naming-convention violations were corrected. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap and SKBitmap pixel-span offset and stride fixed** — GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y) was using Height instead of Width for the X offset, and stride was computed from Width×BytesPerPixel instead of RowBytes, causing incorrect pixel reads on padded bitmaps. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **Default-typeface resolution moved to the managed layer** — The platform default typeface is now resolved in managed code before reaching native, making behaviour consistent across platforms and fixing cases where no text was drawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first fixed** — A finalizer-ordering crash occurred when an SKPath outlived the SKPathBuilder that produced it. The path now holds its own reference to the builder. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **WinUI Projection DLL resolved on .NET 9** — WinUI consumers on .NET 9 no longer hit a missing Projection DLL at runtime. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Android SKGLView rendering restored after MAUI TabBar tab switch** — SKGLView on Android stopped rendering when the containing MAUI TabBar tab was deactivated and reactivated; the surface is now correctly re-established. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton object lifecycle reworked** — The lifetime tracking of singleton SKObject instances (e.g. SKTypeface.Default) was redesigned to prevent finalizer-order crashes and ensure handles are not reused after disposal. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native-compat gate moved from ModuleInitializer to SkiaApi static constructor** — The check that ensures the native library version matches the managed bindings now runs in the SkiaApi static constructor instead of a module initializer, fixing startup ordering issues in some host environments. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic (Android NDK toolchain) native assets added** — Linux Bionic targets used by the Android NDK toolchain are now included in the native asset package. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen x64 and arm64 native build support** — The Tizen native build now produces x64 and arm64 binaries in addition to the existing arm32 target. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple platform TFMs aligned: 26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps** — Apple library TFMs now use the versioned 26.0 form and app TFMs use the unversioned form, fixing asset resolution for .NET 9+ Apple consumers. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **WASM: dropped pre-.NET 8 Emscripten native builds** — Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions targeting pre-.NET 8 runtimes have been removed, reducing package size. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — libpng was updated to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5 and 2.8.1, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype to 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, and HarfBuzz to 14.2.0. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Adds variable-font shaping, color-font palette support, the new HBColor value type for hb_color_t, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz engine to 14.2.0.
